issue.title: Honest disk attribution and an end to the held-workspace re-settlement loop
issue.description: Disk inventory reports unmeasured owners as unknown rather than 0 B, and measures workspace roots before anything else. Pressure recovery runs whether or not attribution is complete, and a missed target produces a distinct escalation. Held workspaces settle once per evidence fingerprint. Their notices get a +1 only when evidence changes, plus an hourly heartbeat on undismissed rows. The notification store skips the rewrite for coalesced and dismissed-row +1s.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/outage_disk_attribution_and_held_workspaces.md requests this work

issue.title: Coalesce identical +1s and stop rewriting the store for dismissed rows
issue.description: store_guard: in sase-core, key-based +1s to dismissed rows become no-ops unless the caller opts in, and identical +1s within a window coalesce. Neither path rewrites the store or bumps its generation. Python adopts the new outcomes, and the pin moves.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/outage_disk_attribution_and_held_workspaces.md defines phase store_guard as one work unit

issue.title: Settle held workspaces once per evidence fingerprint with change-only +1s
issue.description: held_settle: persist an evidence fingerprint and a cheap stat signature with the retention record. Later stale-running cleanup passes over unchanged evidence then skip git probes, snapshots, decision-sheet publishing, and +1s. Add the hourly still-held heartbeat for undismissed rows.

payload.entry:
owner_first is implemented: workspace checkout, shared primary, fixed SASE state, artifact-run, and managed-tmp roots receive one du -skx pass before bucket/detail/stray scans. The independent owner pass uses up to four concurrent du processes, a 60s per-root timeout, and a 90s overall deadline; the existing 5s/50k shared budget remains for details and strays.

Read-only pre-install baseline on 2026-11-19 used `sase workspace list --all --json`, `sase disk list --json`, and `du -skx -- PATH`. Existing disk-list workspace rows were unmeasured:0 except Apollo bob-cli workspace, which was lower_bound:0. Direct du output in KiB, workspace root / shared primary:
Apollo: bob-cli 38824416 / 9841888 (workspace 9.4s); body 5048 / 8644; cash 35160 / 15004; dev 5072 / 13128; job 294312 / 71408; love 147532 / 39044; nut missing / 208; sase 19820544 / 6425420 (workspace 9.9s); tailnet 1110820 / 77392.
Athena: actstat 1616524 / 2088416; body 3763860 / 9576; cash 9884 / 13536; dev 3792532 / 14940; job 64796 / 61788; love 151908 / 41392; bob-cli 36779432 / 7660584 (workspace 19.4s); sase 88334964 / 10143024 (workspace 42.8s); sase-spotify 14720 / 16428; tailnet 988256 / 76864.

The code uses the same du -skx measurement and stores its KiB result multiplied by 1024, so 0 KiB difference is expected for an unchanged root. Compare each workspace row to du on its own path; do not sum nested detail rows, since the classifier removes overlap, including shared Git object paths. After install, repeat `sase disk list --json` on each host and run `du -skx -- PATH` for every section=workspaces path. Post-install comparison remains pending the human-owned global install.

Apollo 2026-11-19 disk_pressure store: 99 rows (97 visible, 2 dismissed, 0 with a dedup_key). 62 lead with "Unattributed …"; newest (2026-11-16T21:06, fa2a3f88) leads with "Unattributed 192.7 GiB on the SASE_HOME filesystem". After-install repeat: ssh apollo -- sase notify list --sender disk_pressure --all --json --limit 10000

Measurement before-numbers (read-only, athena, 2026-11-19 ~09:04 EST): notification-store generation 345269 -> 345289 in 60 s (~20 advances/min) on a 7.3 MB notifications.jsonl; audit baseline was ~16 full rewrites/min and 5,500+ "retained with other dirt" lines per workspace over Nov 17-19. After-install repeat command: g1=$(cat ~/.sase/notifications/notifications.jsonl.generation); sleep 60; g2=$(cat ~/.sase/notifications/notifications.jsonl.generation); echo $((g2-g1)) (expect ~0-1 per hour per hold instead of ~16-20/min).
